title: npm workspaces: lockfile link to packages/shared-kit vs registry shared-kit@2.1.0
notes: Caller apps/web depends on shared-kit via workspace:* and statically imports format + localOnly. Lockfile v3 records link:true resolved to packages/shared-kit (version 0.4.0). Upgrade target is a synthetic registry tarball of the same name. Naive exportDiff looks like a used-export removal; expected nextAction is still unknown.

naiveExportDiffIfIdentitiesWereSame.note: Do not bind this as action. Trees are different identities; exportDiff coverage is conflict.

decisionNotes: Lockfile identity is npm packages{node_modules/shared-kit}.link=true resolved=packages/shared-kit (workspace path, version 0.4.0).
Upgrade target is a registry locator of the same name (synthetic 2.1.0 tarball at example.invalid). Same name is not same identity.
Alias/workspace/lockfile disagreement ⇒ unknown until resolved (packet rule 5).
Conflicting source ⇒ unknown, not action (packet rule 3).
A newer registry version is not itself a break (packet rule 1).
Caller uses localOnly, which is absent from the registry stand-in. That must not become action: the removal is not an upgrade of the workspace package.
workspace:* is not a semver range that includes registry 2.1.0; swapping protocol is an identity change.
Nested workspace dep shared-kit-core is part of the local identity and is absent from the registry stand-in; that still does not justify action.
